inference: The exact multiplayer WB pointer in each selected root leads to the corresponding PBNS object 1. Its Field_1f7b3933 local pointer selects Class_9966532d object 7, whose values are mapped in FIELD_MAP as blast fields.

Frag object 7 imports the scoped FragGrenade_BlastDamageFalloff_Curve object 1. MiniV40 object 7 has a local Field_0df20cb3 reference to object 14 in PBNS_MiniV40. Both selected data objects expose Field_edfc6df6 arrays of Struct_c45202f2 with the same mapped distance/damage members.
The selected source chain supports comparing serialized field values and typed curve points. It does not establish effective in-game damage or physical coverage.
unresolved: The selected Field_0bf4f62b and Field_5ef7b9a1 f32 fields are inside Class_990616ac; FIELD_MAP names these hashes as InitialSpeed and TimeToLive on Class_23637dce. Their exact PBNS owner-specific meanings remain unresolved.
Struct_739f3ac5.Field_32a99b9c differs (10 versus 18). FIELD_MAP associates this exact member with Shot.InitialSpeed.z in WB shot context, but the PBNS Field_8bf976c1 parent meaning is unresolved.

BlastDamage, BlastRadius, InnerBlastRadius, ShockwaveDamage, ShockwaveRadius and curve point fields are serialized typed values. Their units, damage composition, curve interpolation and runtime activation are not established here.

The coverage DB labels the Frag/Mini PBNS root captures decoded-provisional; the fresh decoder resolves each local class key against the pinned hotfix descriptor, and all claimed scalar and pointer offsets were independently checked from raw bytes. The decoder warning remains recorded.
siteImpact: Propose an optional Frag versus Mini V40 blast-profile comparison for operator review. The selected source chains store BlastDamage 100 versus 40, equal mapped blast radii, and distinct falloff point lists. Do not show these as effective in-game damage or physical coverage until units, interpolation and damage composition are validated.
